svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Rajendran. I study computing science at Heriot-Watt in Kuala Lumpur and run Sennova AI, where I build automation tools for small businesses. I'm learning machine learning and looking for a data or AI internship. Tools: Python, R, SQL and MySQL for data work. Tableau and Power BI for showing results. Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, Tailwind and Bootstrap for building things. Also AWS, Figma and Arduino.
